# Repository Tags Guide

This document outlines the tags used in the Bio repository for categorization and discoverability.

## Issue & PR Labels

### Priority
- `P0-critical` - Immediate fix required (e.g., login broken, data loss)
- `P1-high` - Important issues requiring attention soon
- `P2-medium` - Standard priority items
- `P3-low` - Nice-to-have improvements

### Type
- `bug` - Something isn't working correctly
- `enhancement` - New feature or request
- `documentation` - Improvements to documentation
- `question` - Further information is requested
- `good first issue` - Good for newcomers
- `help wanted` - Extra attention is needed
- `wontfix` - This will not be worked on
- `duplicate` - Already exists
- `invalid` - This doesn't seem right

### Area
- `cloudfunctions` - Backend cloud function related
- `miniprogram` - Frontend mini-program related
- `webadmin` - Web admin panel (React + Vite)
- `3d-model` - 3D model viewer, library and generation pipeline
- `ui/ux` - User interface/experience
- `performance` - Performance optimization
- `security` - Security concerns
- `testing` - Test coverage
- `build` - Build system or CI/CD
- `dependencies` - Dependency updates

### Status
- `in-progress` - Currently being worked on
- `review` - Awaiting code review
- `awaiting-approval` - Waiting for approval
- `blocked` - Blocked by external factors
- `merged` - Successfully merged

### Platform
- `ios` - iOS specific
- `android` - Android specific
- `webadmin` - Web admin panel
- `weixin` - WeChat related
